usage: agentware graph checkpoint [-h] [--format {text,json}]
                                  --verdict {proceed,hold,abort-subtree}
                                  [--actor {loop,operator}] [--handle HANDLE]
                                  [--host HOST] [--now NOW]
                                  name node

positional arguments:
  name                  graph name
  node                  node the verdict applies to

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {text,json}  output format (default: text)
  --verdict {proceed,hold,abort-subtree}
                        proceed|hold|abort-subtree
  --actor {loop,operator}
                        who records the verdict (default: operator)
  --handle HANDLE       actor handle (optional)
  --host HOST           actor host (optional)
  --now NOW             inject the clock (ISO)
